      • append

      • equals

        boolean equals​(java.lang.Object o)
        Returns true if this List is equal to o. Note that o must refer to a List, and o can't be null. Furthermore, corresponding positions in each List must have equal elements. For example, if List x has state <abc> and List y has state <abc> then x.equals(y) is true. if List z has state <a> then x.equals(z) is false.
        Overrides:
        equals in class java.lang.Object
        Parameters:
        o - object to which this List is compared
        Returns:
        true if this List equals o as described above

      • get

  throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
        Returns the ith character in this List. Examples: <abc>.get(0) == 'a' <abc>.get(3) !! IllegalArgumentException
        Parameters:

        Returns:
        character at index i
        Throws:

      • insert

        void insert​(char c,
            int i)
     throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
        Inserts c at index i. The element originally at index i becomes the element that comes next after the newly inserted character.
        Parameters:
        c - character to insert
        i - index at which to insert c
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if i is not a valid index

      • remove

        void remove​(int i)
     throws java.lang.IllegalArgumentException
        Removes the element at index i. The element originally at index i+1 is at index i after the remove() method returns.
        Parameters:
        i - index of element to remove from this List
        Throws:
        java.lang.IllegalArgumentException - if i is not a valid index

      • toString

        java.lang.String toString()
        Returns the state string of this List. The state string starts with "<" followed by the characters of the List from first to last without any punctuation, then ending with ">". For example, the List with characters 'a' then 'b' then 'c' has the state string "<abc>"
        Overrides:
        toString in class java.lang.Object
        Returns:
        state string of this List
